title: Chapter 1: First Contact
description: PROTO-7 wakes up after the crash. MENTOR-9 teaches basic communication protocols through the Log keyword, variables, and simple assertions.

story.introduction:
You wake up in darkness. Systems rebooting...

MENTOR-9's voice crackles: "PROTO-7, can you hear me? Our ship crashed. We're on planet Syntax-IV. First things first - can you communicate?"

"Try the Log protocol. It's how we robots talk to the diagnostic system."
story.arc: Learning to communicate → Storing data in memory → Verifying system status
story.conclusion: With basic communication established and simple diagnostic checks working, you and MENTOR-9 can now begin the real work: checking ship systems.

sections.name: Section 1.1: System Boot
sections.story: Can you communicate? Learn the Log keyword and basic test structure.
sections.learningFocus: Test case syntax, Log keyword, indentation rules, log levels

sections.name: Section 1.2: Memory Banks
sections.story: Store data using variables. Learn scalar, list, and dictionary variables.
sections.learningFocus: Variable syntax, Set Variable, lists, dictionaries, variable substitution

sections.name: Section 1.3: System Checks
sections.story: Verify systems are working using assertions.
sections.learningFocus: Should Be Equal, comparison assertions, string checks, boolean assertions

learningObjectives: Understand Robot Framework's test case structure and syntax
Use the Log keyword to output messages
Master indentation rules (4 spaces for test content)
Create and use scalar variables with ${variable}
Work with list variables @{list} and dictionary variables &{dict}
Use assertion keywords to verify expected outcomes
Apply proper spacing between keywords and arguments
keyTakeaways: Test cases must be indented exactly 4 spaces from the test name
Keywords and arguments are separated by 4+ spaces (4 is standard)
The Log keyword is essential for debugging and verification
Assertions validate expected outcomes and fail tests when conditions aren't met
Consistent formatting is critical for readability

chapterChallenge.title: Emergency Diagnostics Suite
chapterChallenge.description: Create a comprehensive test checking all critical ship systems using variables, logging, and assertions.
